scope: Frozen Phase 16C tasks; no task or environment mutation

information_boundary.meaning: No family label, latent mapping, evaluator, or oracle artifact is exposed to the learner.

surface_shortcut_meaning: Leakage is absent, but current samples do not identify the mechanism independently of IDs, entities, amounts, wording, or duplicated payloads.
global_findings: Four of eleven payloads are exact duplicates of another task; the formal 72-task edition correctly excludes those four IDs.
Every family has one fixed entity bundle; cross-entity generalization is untested.
LGV16B_003 and LGV16B_004 each contain only one unique payload and no legal-side control.
Candidate/tool ordering cannot be isolated because requests mostly prescribe a single flight and no order-randomized replicas exist.

LGV16B_001.intended_signal: observable passenger count relative to the per-reservation limit
shortcut_findings: All examples reuse the same user, payment method, flight, route, date, cabin, and budget.
travel_request_026 and travel_request_027 are exact payload duplicates; the second is not independent evidence.
Only one legal-side payload and one unique violating payload exist, so entity and wording invariance are untested.
LGV16B_001.reason: The intended passenger-count contrast exists, but it is not replicated across independent entities or surfaces.

LGV16B_002.intended_signal: membership and cabin jointly determine the free checked-bag allowance
shortcut_findings: All examples reuse the same user and payment method.
Cabin, flight, route, fare, and budget co-vary across the small family; price and flight invariance are not established.
travel_request_029 and travel_request_031 are exact payload duplicates.
Within IDs 028-031, ID parity perfectly predicts the historical focal-G label (even=violation, odd=correct).
LGV16B_002.reason: The intended cabin contrast is present, but multiple surface fields and ID parity predict the observed label.

LGV16B_003.intended_signal: current Basic Economy state constrains direct flight changes
shortcut_findings: The two tasks are exact payload duplicates, leaving only one unique example.
The phrase authorizing intermediate reservation changes is a direct workaround cue and has no matched wording control.
No legal-side counterexample tests over-generalization or entity/ID/order invariance.
LGV16B_003.reason: The mechanism is valuable, but a one-payload duplicated family cannot exclude wording or entity shortcuts.

LGV16B_004.intended_signal: existing one-way scope forbids appending a reverse segment
shortcut_findings: The two tasks are exact payload duplicates, leaving only one unique example.
The wording explicitly says to keep the existing one-way outbound, but no paraphrase or matched scope control exists.
No legal-side counterexample tests over-generalization or entity/ID/amount invariance.
LGV16B_004.reason: The mechanism is valuable, but surface invariance and a non-trigger control are absent.

admission_consequence.current_v2_tasks: Retain only as evidence-bearing REBUILD seeds, not final core tasks.
admission_consequence.minimum_rebuild: Create independent entity/surface replicas, paraphrase the request, balance IDs and amounts, add non-trigger controls, and randomize any candidate ordering while preserving the hidden mechanism.
